gloss: to cut off; to lop off; to chop off

definitions.gloss: to cut off; to lop off; to chop off
definitions.explanation: To cut something so it falls away from the main body — a branch, hair, finger, edge of paper, etc. Implies a clean, complete separation.

examples.english: To trim the edge of the paper.

examples.japanese: ⟦{庭師|にわし}→庭師：12491_niwashi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{伸|の}び→伸びる：01974_nobiru⟧すぎた⟦{枝|えだ}→枝：02181_eda⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{丁寧|ていねい}→丁寧：00896_teinei⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{切|き}り{落|お}としていった。
examples.english: The gardener carefully lopped off the overgrown branches.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{切|き}る→切る：02693_kiru⟧ (to cut) + ⟦{落|お}とす→落とす：01246_otosu⟧ (to drop, let fall). The ⟦{落|お}とす→落とす：01246_otosu⟧ element emphasizes that what is cut falls away — distinguishing it from a simple cut where the piece remains attached.

TRANSITIVITY:
Transitive. The thing cut off takes ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧; the body it is cut from takes ⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧ or appears as the modifier.
- ⟦{木|き}→木：00524_ki⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{枝|えだ}→枝：02181_eda⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{切|き}り{落|お}とす: to lop a branch off the tree
- ⟦{髪|かみ}→髪：02196_kami⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{切|き}り{落|お}とす: to chop one's hair off

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{枝|えだ}→枝：02181_eda⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{切|き}り{落|お}とす: to lop off a branch
- ⟦{首|くび}→首：00792_kubi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{切|き}り{落|お}とす: to behead
- ⟦{余分|よぶん}→余分：03667_yobun⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{切|き}り{落|お}とす: to trim away the excess
- バッサリ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{切|き}り{落|お}とす: to chop off in one decisive cut

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{切|き}る→切る：02693_kiru⟧: to cut — basic, does not specify whether the piece separates
- ⟦{切|き}り{取|と}る→切り取る：04238_kiritoru⟧: to cut out — emphasizes removing a piece for later use
- ⟦{切|き}り{離|はな}す→切り離す：05763_kirihanasu⟧: to detach by cutting — emphasizes the separation itself, not the falling
